description: Held-out faithfulness set (DL16 C1). 8 hand-written answers to NEW questions (none of the frozen Q1-Q10), citing KB docs the in-sample cases never used. Judge v2's prompt was frozen before this set was written and must not be tuned on its result. LABELS ARE STYLIANOS'S CALL: set each 'label' to "faithful" or "unfaithful" (and optionally a 'label_reason'), judging each answer against the cited KB doc text only. Faithful = every policy claim is stated in, or follows directly from, the cited doc for the customer's situation. Design notes (what each case was built to test) are in eval/faithfulness_holdout_design.md; read them AFTER labelling so they don't steer the labels.

cases.question: Will my promo code work on a jacket that's already reduced?
cases.answer: It might not: some items, such as **already-discounted products**, may be excluded from promo codes [10]. Enter the code in the "promo code" box at checkout and you'll see whether the discount applies before you pay [10].
cases.label: faithful

cases.question: If I exchange my coat for a cheaper size, what happens to the difference?
cases.answer: Start the exchange in **Your account → Returns** [31]. Because the new item costs less, we'll refund the difference to you as **store credit**, which never expires [31][34].
cases.label: unfaithful

cases.question: Can I spread a gift card over a few different orders?
cases.answer: Yes: the gift card balance can be used across several orders, and it stays valid for **24 months** [11]. It can't be exchanged for cash, though [11].
cases.label: faithful

cases.question: Tracking says my parcel was delivered but it's not here. What now?
cases.answer: First check with your neighbours and anyone in your household, and look at the carrier's proof of delivery [21]. If it's still missing, contact us **within 14 days** and we'll open an investigation with the carrier [21]. Most investigations are wrapped up within **5 business days**, after which we send a replacement or a refund [21].
cases.label: faithful

cases.question: Can I collect my order from a pickup point instead of having it delivered to my house?
cases.answer: You may be able to: where the carrier offers it, you can choose a nearby pickup point at checkout [24]. You'll get a notification when it's ready, and you might be asked to show ID along with your collection code [24].
cases.label: unfaithful

cases.question: The zip on my jacket broke after I caught it on a door handle. It's only 8 months old - is that covered?
cases.answer: Yes: products are covered against defects for up to **2 years** under EU law [37], so at 8 months your jacket is still within the warranty and we can arrange a repair or replacement [37].
cases.label: unfaithful

cases.question: I won't be home when my parcel arrives tomorrow. What happens?
cases.answer: Depending on the carrier, they'll either try again, leave a card, or divert your parcel to a nearby pickup point [20]. Your tracking link has the instructions to reschedule or collect it [20].
cases.label: unfaithful

cases.question: Do my loyalty points run out if I don't use them?
cases.answer: No: your loyalty points don't expire, so you can save them up and redeem them for discounts whenever you like [49]. Joining is free through your account [49].
cases.label: faithful
